test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.

Many families are __so poor__ to bear the cost of educating all their children.
solution:
The correct answer is too poor.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• “Too” is an **adverb**. It can be used to replace words such as “excessively”, “additionally”, etc.

 
 
• For example: It is too</strong&g
